sourceFile: 67. TIU C11-20 Report Test AWF JIG new improve 2026.3.2_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not approvable because it misidentifies the changed factor and mismatches Normal versus Test AWF JIG comparisons.
issues: Changed factor should be Test/New AWF JIG vs Normal, not shift or TOTAL.
Date and shift subgroup pairing is not preserved.
Per-row comparisons incorrectly use the total Normal row as control.
Rows 48 and 50 are omitted from detailed comparisons.
Measurement outcome is spurious; these are defect-count categories.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new/Test AWF JIG, baseline Normal.
Use date and line/shift as subgroup keys; keep TOTAL as aggregate only.
Pair rows 36/38, 40/42, 44/46, and 48/50 for detailed results.
Keep rows 32/34 as aggregate total comparison.
Remove measurement outcome or recast defect categories under process defect outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Source rows are citeable, but current citations and grouping are insufficient for final evidence.
